properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the signature/key curve for the Tron chain plugin and for restored private keys (RestorePrivateKeyViewModel validates imported keys against the secp256k1 group order before use). The curve is fixed by the blockchain protocols this wallet serves — observable here, replaceable only at the chain level, not unilaterally by this app. Private keys on secp256k1 are harvest-now-decrypt-later material.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Posture control, present and correct: the local-backup password MAC is compared with JCA's constant-time MessageDigest.isEqual rather than ==/Arrays.equals, preventing a timing oracle on the backup MAC check.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (Ethereum's pre-FIPS-202 variant, not FIPS SHA3-256) in two roles: EvmAddressValidator implements the EIP-55 mixed-case address checksum, and EncryptDecryptManager.generateMac computes the keystore-style MAC over derived key + ciphertext that passwordIsCorrect verifies for the encrypted local backup. Digest is quantum-resistant for these purposes; recorded as the digest actually in use.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Gradle wrapper integrity manifest (SHA-256 digest of gradle-wrapper.jar, consumed by Gradle's wrapper verification). Build-supply-chain integrity control, not application cryptography — recorded so the CBOM reflects the digest the build pipeline trusts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test/debug APK-signing keystore committed to the repo, with BOTH passwords hardcoded right next to it (app/build.gradle.kts:64/66: storePassword = keyPassword = "testKeystore123"); signs debug, ci and fdroidCi builds (build.gradle.kts:95/104/114). Debug-grade material and deliberately public, but it is committed signing key material whose credentials are in version control — worth confirming no release signing key ever follows the same pattern. Changeable here (repo hygiene).
